question: Что такое Relationships и как это работает?
short_answer: A relationship describes ORM navigation between entities; the foreign key column remains the database source of referential truth.
junior_answer: A relationship describes ORM navigation between entities; the foreign key column remains the database source of referential truth. `back_populates` connects both directions; one-to-many, many-to-one and many-to-many determine collection/scalar shape and loading behavior. Важное ограничение: Relationship does not automatically choose efficient eager loading or safe cascade semantics.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с Relationships?
follow_up_answer: Confusing ORM relationship with database ownership can configure delete cascade that removes more data than intended.
